query_text: Create a dumbbell chart for the 10 countries with the largest positive best-city advantage in the 2021 report, where each country has one point for `covid_rank` and one point for the best visible city rank from `city_rankings`, the selection metric is `covid_rank - best visible city rank`, values are rank positions, Canada and Sweden are excluded because of documented city-rank conflicts, and countries are sorted by the largest positive advantage after the gap is derived.
selection_rule: positive advantages only, capped at top 10 after excluding Canada/Sweden
